1: The door back out to Warrior City.
W: Shelves to the ceiling. Somebody has catalogued them by smell.
T: A bookcase. HISTORY OF THE EIGHT KINGDOMS, volumes one to forty. Volume nine is missing.
B: A bookcase of maps, folded wrong.
t: A reading table. A book lies open: 'On the Bridges Between the Kingdoms.'
L: A lectern, and on it a heavy book: THE BUBBLE. Someone has written in the margin: 'and what's outside it?'
p: A fern that has read more than most people.

objects.name: Quill
lines: Oh! Oh, you're real! I've read about you. Well, not you. People like you. Travellers.
Quill. Mage. I came in for one book five hundred years ago and I'm still on the index.

objects.name: Librarian Pell
lines: Shh. No, you can talk. I just like saying it.

answer: Volume nine. The years the old king went mad. Borrowed, five hundred years ago, by the palace.
Never returned. I've sent a great many letters.

questions.ask: Nobody reads your letters, you know.
